name: atomic-phone-tools
description: Asset pipeline for phone.atomicai.ch — GLB optimisation, studio HDRI generation, poster rendering.

scripts.optimize: for f in ../../Colorway-2/*/*.glb; do node optimize.mjs "$f" "../models/$(basename "$f")" 'tex=2048 q=88'; node optimize.mjs "$f" "../models/m/$(basename "$f")" 'tex=1024 q=85'; done
